ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO

ALTHOUGH TITIPO DREAMS OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN IN THE WORLD, HIS CURIOUS PERSONALITY ALWAYS LEADS HIM TO UNEXPECTED EVENTS AND PROBLEMS EVERY DAY. TITIPO EXPANDS HIS EXPERIENCE IN A BIGGER WORLD AND BECOMES FRIENDS WITH GENIE, DIESEL, AND OTHER LITTLE TRAINS. WILL TITIPO ACHIEVE HIS DREAM OF BECOMING THE BEST TRAIN? JOIN THE TRAIN JOURNEY AND MEET TITIPO AND THE LITTLE TRAIN FRIENDS.

When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN

They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA

With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN

In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: BLUEY

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION

IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
